sentences.en: The tribal wise man shared his knowledge with all the young.
sentences.zh: 部落里的智者向所有年轻人分享了他的知识。

sentences.en: Are you still able to speak your tribal language?
sentences.zh: 你还能说你们部落的语言吗？

sentences.en: Democrats and tribal groups hailed Haaland's confirmation as historic.
sentences.zh: 民主党和土著团体庆祝哈兰德的确认具有历史意义。

senses.zh: 部落的，种族的；氏族的，宗族的
